known_gaps: Planner produced placeholders only; subject writers still need to author full pages from the suggested evidence paths.
The file map was sampled through top-level docs and representative implementation files, not every individual TypeScript source file.
Archived design material under docs/archive/ was not inspected in detail because active docs mark it as historical unless cited by canonical docs.
Existing generated project outputs under projects/ and state/ were not deeply inspected; they should be used cautiously as run evidence or serving state, not as canonical product design.
The manifest intentionally separates Session Memory, Project Memory, and retrieval/storage subjects because the repo treats those as distinct product boundaries.
